reason: The three-line rig should secure the whale in the chosen flight space.
expectation: The whale will be tethered so its height and direction are limited.

effect: The whale is now on the garden tether; it still needs the rest of its flight setup.
reaction: The tether is a sensible first safety step.
reason: The aiming wedge should help point the whale's projector at the nearby screen.
expectation: The projector will be aimed toward the cloth screen.

effect: The whale is aimed at the garden screen; the tether-side control panel remains to be fitted.
reason: The control panel is the remaining visible part of the flight setup.
expectation: The panel will provide controls beside the tether and help complete the flight setup.

effect: The control panel completed the garden setup, with the lines, controls and clear path checked while the whale remained in its cradle.
reaction: The safety check was reassuring, though the airborne show is still to come.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the three-line tether was the most worthwhile step: it gave the flight space a clear safety purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: Aiming the projector was straightforward, with little to figure out from the result.

surprise.text: The completed setup leaves the airborne show until the guests arrive, rather than flying it now.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; each named part had an apparent role in the setup.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see the flying show, since this chapter prepared for it without showing it.
